title: Convolve, filter, and measure a room
brief: Convolve directly and through the FFT without wrap-around, run an IIR filter from its difference equation, pre-emphasize speech, and build and measure a synthetic room.
hints: In convolve_direct, y[k:k + len(x)] += h[k] * x adds one tap's contribution with one vector operation.
The next power of two at or above n is 1 << (n - 1).bit_length().
np.polyval(c[::-1], z) evaluates c[0] + c[1] z + c[2] z**2 + ...; with z = np.exp(-1j * w) that is sum_k c[k] e^{-jwk}.
In lfilter, the feedback sum starts at k = 1 and uses outputs you already computed; guard every index so n - k never goes below 0.
The energy still to come is a reversed cumulative sum: np.cumsum((h ** 2)[::-1])[::-1].
